title: Returns and exchanges on the phone
problem: Every return in the app sent people to the web.
now: The app finds the sale by number, mobile or a scan, takes items back, refunds or swaps them, and returns stock to sale or to damaged.
steps: Open the app's POS, tap the shift, then Return or exchange
Search a sale or scan its receipt
Tick an item, pick a reason and Cash, then Confirm return
Try Exchange and pick another item
On an order page tap Return or exchange: the sale opens, and Back returns to the order
left: Courier return parcels are still received on the web (/courier-returns).
notes: Where: App: More › Return or exchange (/m-return); POS › shift sheet
